question: A can do a certain work in 15 days and B can do one-third of the same work in 10 days. A and B work together for 6 days and then A leaves. B completes the remaining work with C in 8 days. A and C together can complete the original work in :
solution:
**Given: **

A does a work in 15 days.

B does ((1)/(3))rd work in 10 days 

**Calculations:**

B can do the work in = 30 days 

Let us suppose C can do the same work in X days .

Now , A and B can do the part of work in 1 day is 

= (1)/(15)+(1)/(30)

= (3)/(30)

= (1)/(10) th part of work

Therefore, A and B together can do the work in 10 days ,but they only did for 6 days 

and the part of work done in 6 days is = (6)/(10)th part of work .

Now, The Remaining work = 1-(6)/(10) = (6)/(10)= (2)/(5)th part of work .

Now , according to question B and C did the remaining work in 8 days 

Hence, in 1 day work done by B and C together is = (1)/(20)th part of work

Therefore, one day work of B and C together is

 = (1)/(30)+(1)/(X)

But , it is given = (1)/(20) as B and C does (2)/(5) th part of work in 8 days. 

Hence, (1)/(30)+(1)/(X)=(1)/(20)

Rightarrow(1)/(X)=(1)/(20)-(1)/(30)

Rightarrow X = 60 days 

Hence , A and C can do the work in 1 day

= (1)/(15)+(1)/(60)

= (5)/(60)

= (1)/(12)th part of work

Hence , A and C can together do (1)/(12) th part of work in 1day

**Therefore, A and C can together do 1 work in 12 days.**
